name: Inter
meaning: bury the sick under sick earth, which goes on breathing it out
why: Disease is Earth + Death, and nothing in the old set came from Earth. Inter is Earth's Raise and Bury through Death's Lay: a barrow. A Frame (it holds a structure up: the mound), draw +0.6 because it holds the sickness in the ground.

name: Exhume
meaning: dig up the buried, and the grave-rot with it
why: Earth's Dig through Death's corpses: the rot that is already in the ground and the dead comes up. A Branch (one cast opens several graves), draw -0.6 because it releases outward; opposite Inter, so the pair bonds ionically.
